messages.subject: For Richard Stewart | Stakeholder leadership, responsible growth and strategic execution
messages.body:
Dear Sibanye-Stillwater Investor and Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Richard Stewart, Chief Executive Officer.

Sibanye-Stillwater's refreshed strategy places performance, portfolio discipline and growth at the center of its next phase. Execution across a diversified mining group also depends on consistent stakeholder confidence, strong community relationships and clear accountability for social and regulatory commitments.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a large mining operation. I manage complex external issues through structured ownership, evidence, deadlines and executive escalation across multiple operating functions.

I would value a conversation about where this experience might support Sibanye-Stillwater's stakeholder, social-performance, responsible-growth or country-facing leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that fit.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
